name: Arcane Grimoire, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +3 to your Wizard spell attacks and save DC; Arcane Recovery brings back one more slot level.
text: This leather-bound tome works as a spellbook. While it is in your hand, your Wizard spells can channel through it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain +3 to their spell attack rolls and their saving throw DCs. Whenever you use Arcane Recovery, the total of spell slot levels you get back rises by 1.
